title: The ‘Outer Banks’ Cast Joins an Exclusive ‘Front Row’ Special on SiriusXM Hits 1
summary: Chase Stokes, Jonathan Daviss, and Drew Starkey joined The Morning Mash Up to discuss the final season of their hit series.
body_markdown:
*Outer Banks* stars **Chase Stokes, Jonathan Daviss, and Drew** **Starkey** **** sat down with[SiriusXM Hits 1’s The Morning Mash Up](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/morning-mash-up) to discuss the final season of their hit Netflix show.


[Outer Banks Front Row Premiering Thursday, August 20 on SiriusXM Hits 1 Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogOuterBanksHits1)


During the exclusive ***Outer Banks Front Row*** event, the cast also revealed that Oscar-winning actor[Robert De Niro](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/robert-de-niro) watches the Netflix hit with his daughter and contacted the cast to help celebrate her birthday.


“Robert De Niro watches the show. He watches it with his daughter,” Daviss said. “He asked us to do a FaceTime call for his daughter on her birthday.”


“We were like, ‘Yeah, right now — we’ll do it right now. Absolutely,’” he added.


- **Related:[Listen to SiriusXM’s Toy Story 5 Front Row Featuring the Movie’s Stars](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/toy-story-5-front-row)**


And De Niro isn’t *Outer Banks* ‘ only A-list viewer. The cast revealed that **Matt Damon** is also familiar with the series thanks to his daughters.


The stars also looked back at the show’s unlikely rise from a series that debuted during the COVID-19 lockdown to a global phenomenon. Without the usual opportunities to encounter fans, the cast initially relied on social media to gauge its popularity.


“I honestly didn’t feel it until season two,” **Starkey said** . “I was like, ‘Oh, people really connect with the show.’”


Listen to the entire ***Outer Banks Front Row*** **on[SiriusXM Hits 1 (Ch. 2)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-hits-1) and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogOuterBanksHits1) starting August 20. Plus, watch a clip from it above now.**
